newsitem.title: GERMANY: Banks lift IBIS DAX, technical problems cause delay.
newsitem.headline: Banks lift IBIS DAX, technical problems cause delay.

text.p: News of a merger between Hypo-Bank and Vereinsbank drove the German share market skywards in early trade, but the market had settled back before a technical problem stopped IBIS trade and delayed floor trade.
The IBIS DAX index was up 20.45 points at 4,152.39 points when trade was halted. The DAX index ended on Friday at 4,196.53 points.
"The markets were euphoric because of the banks and this pushed Wall Street weakness aside," a Frankfurt trader said. The Dow Jones index ended down 1.62 percent at 7,890.46 points on Friday.
